title: Affine weakly contractible covering family on the pro-etale site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Every object $U$ of this site admits a covering family $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ in which each $U_i$ is affine and weakly contractible for the full site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Here weakly contractible means that for every epimorphism $F\to G$ of sheaves of sets on this site, $F(U_i)\to G(U_i)$ is surjective.

proof.text: Take A = U.left.affineOpenCover. Its index is small and its members are spectra of rings, with open-immersion arrows covering U.left. Apply lem-weil-pbc-affine-contractible-extension-full-site separately to each A.X j, obtaining D j, phi j, singleton pro-etale coverings p j and the full-site evaluation property for every structural map out of Spec(D j).

Weaken the affine open cover to the big pro-etale precoverage using Mathlib zariskiPrecoverage_le_propQCPrecoverage, and bind it with the singleton covers p j. Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.bind proves that the composites form a pro-etale precoverage covering; its proof already supplies the finite-open refinements required in the original plan. Reindex with Equiv.ulift to obtain an index in Type (u+1). This works for an arbitrary scheme, without quasi-compactness of U, and the empty scheme gives the empty indexed cover.

Each composite in the resulting cover B is weakly etale, by the morphism-property clause of the pro-etale precoverage (Cover.forgetQc and Cover.map_prop). Compose it with U.hom and use Mathlib weak-etale composition stability to form V i = ProEt.mk (B.f i >> U.hom). Form f i : V i -> U with MorphismProperty.Over.homMk. The definition of the small-site precoverage as a comap and Presieve.map_ofArrows identify the desired covering assertion with B.mem_0.

The source scheme of V i is definitionally Spec(D i.down.1), hence affine. Apply the full-site evaluation clause supplied in step 1 to the structural map B.f i >> U.hom and the given sheaf epimorphism. This gives exactly the last clause of the statement on the site of X. All witness selection occurs inside this existential theorem proof, and introduces no definition depending on unproved data.
